theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) [Module.Finite ℤ R] [Module.Free ℤ R] : 1 < Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal := by
  have hprime : v.asIdeal.IsPrime := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.prime R v
  have hmaximal : v.asIdeal.IsMaximal := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.isMaximal R v
  have hneq : v.asIdeal ≠ ⊥ := by rwa [Ideal.eq_bot]
  have hnotunit : ¬v.asIdeal.IsUnit := by intro h; rw [Ideal.eq_bot] at h; exact hneq h
  have hnontriv : Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero] at h; exact hneq h
  exact lt_irrefl (Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal) (by rw [hnontriv]; exact zero_lt_one)
